items.title: Avery Dennison (AVY) Is Up 12.6% After EPS Beat And Higher 2026 Guidance Has The Bull Case Changed?
items.summary: Avery Dennison’s recent quarter delivered revenue of US$2.46 billion and non-GAAP earnings per share of US$2.89, both ahead of analyst expectations, while management issued full-year 2026 EPS guidance of US$9.40 to US$9.70. The company also continued returning cash to shareholders, completing US$482.59 million of buybacks since April 2025 and affirming a quarterly dividend of US$1.00 per share payable in September 2026.
